limitations: This supplemental protocol was specified after inspecting the original test. Its added test comparisons are descriptive, not a new untouched model-selection experiment.
Expanding folds are retrospective development studies on one originator. The primary fitted model, labels and frozen test remain unchanged.
Segment rates and calibration describe conditional observations with repeated loans. Small event counts and common-month dependence prevent unqualified significance claims.
Development-versus-test composition changes reflect cohort seasoning, selection and vintages as well as possible performance drift; they are not a causal stability test.
Aggregate event-exposure errors use actual beginning balances; they are not actual chargeoff, prepayment or investment cash errors.
Economic default dates, recovery cash allocation and exact tape/certificate cash reconciliation remain subject to the separately documented source exceptions.
No method must outperform every comparator to pass this diagnostic. Results are reported without selecting or refitting the primary model.

supplemental_protocol.cohort_prior: Development-only constant probabilities with one added count per cause
supplemental_protocol.expanding_training: CAOT-2024-2 labels accepted strictly before fold origin; collection months no later than June2025
supplemental_protocol.expanding_model: Fresh development-only imputer and scaler; uncalibrated multinomial logistic C1 max_iterations350 seed7
supplemental_protocol.eligibility: Unchanged disclosure_features public availability, terminal-event, repurchase and censoring rules
supplemental_protocol.interpretation: Descriptive supplemental diagnostics after primary test inspection; no model selection or superiority acceptance requirement

primary_refit.method: regularized multinomial logistic competing-event model with development-only calibration
primary_refit.purpose: Reproduce unchanged primary predictions for fixed-segment diagnostics; no primary outputs overwritten
